title: Geologic Map of the Pineland Quadrangle, Hampton and Jasper Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2013, Geologic Map of the Pineland Quadrangle, Hampton and Jasper Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-163, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; the map face is garbled. Deposits under a formation heading are tied to it from the layout and flagged inferred. Legend symbols: Qe and QPwsr are printed after their descriptions (inferred); QPphr ('@Pphr') and QPwr ('aPwr') corrected from the text layer (inferred, noted); '[ aPtme |', 'Phe.', 'piq,' and '.|' are garbled and not recorded. Three thicknesses read '|' for 1 are flagged inferred and marked unclear for a check against the map image. Bodies of standing water not recorded. Portions of Georgia not mapped. The sheet says its products are provided 'as is' without warranty.
SUBSURFACE: p. 1 gives elevation ranges of each unit's seaward and landward margins (Ten Mile Hill beds 25-35 ft, Ladson 35-57 ft, Penholoway 57-70 ft, Wicomico 70-90 ft) and a Dean Swamp member shoreline 90 ft above modern sea level, stored as unit descriptions. Drill holes are plotted with SCGS log numbers (labels garbled) but no depths; logs on file at SCGS. No cross section or structure-contour map. Datum: horizontal 1927 North American Datum; vertical datum for the elevations not stated ('modern sea level').
